summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing its interim report to shareholders for Q1 2026, along with CEO and CFO certifications under Canadian law. The filing is a routine periodic report disclosing financial results such as revenues of $18,580M and net income of $1,042M. It does not announce any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The document is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. As a foreign private issuer's routine quarterly report, it falls outside the special-situations classification.
